name: Yubikiri Kon'yaku Lolita
original_name: ゆびきり婚約ロリイタ
source:
"I will marry you when you grow up"

She came over, relying on an innocent promise.
Under the same roof, with no one to disturb us,
let us melt in our warmth, drawn in love and sweat.
You will soon be unable to live without me... 
and you won't even notice it.
translation:
“等你长大后，我就嫁给你。”

她依靠那句天真的约定来到这里。
在同一屋檐下，无人打扰，
让我们在爱与汗水中彼此融化。
你很快就会无法离开我……
而且连自己都不会察觉。
